description: This file defines the Aws\Sqs\SqsClient class which provides client methods to interact with Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS). It includes methods for queue URL to ARN conversion, MD5 validation of message attributes, and hooks into request handling for checksum validation.

classes.name: Aws\Sqs\SqsClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon SQS, providing methods to perform operations like sending, receiving messages, and queue management, with added checksum validation.

methods.name: getQueueArn
methods.description: Converts an SQS queue URL into an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for identification.

methods.name: calculateMessageAttributesMd5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash of message attributes according to SQS specifications for message validation.

methods.name: calculateBodyMd5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash of the message body.

methods.name: getEncodedStringPiece
methods.description: Encodes a string piece to prepare for MD5 calculation.

methods.name: getEncodedBinaryPiece
methods.description: Encodes a binary piece for MD5 calculation.

methods.name: getFourBytePieceLength
methods.description: Returns the 4-byte length prefix for a given string, used in encoding message attributes.

methods.name: validateMd5
methods.description: Provides a method to validate the MD5 checksum of received messages and attributes within the request handling pipeline.
